content.stem: 年度风险评估包括固有风险、控制措施的有效性以及剩余风险。固有风险被评估为“中等”，而控制措施的有效性为“低于令人满意”。剩余风险的结论最有可能是什么？

options.A: “中等”，因为控制措施薄弱会导致剩余风险保持不变
options.B: “高”，因为控制措施薄弱会导致剩余风险增加
options.C: “中等”，因为特定区域的风险结论可能会有所增加
options.D: “低”，因为控制措施会降低风险

content.stem_en: An annual risk assessment includes inherent risk, effectiveness of controls, and residual risk. The inherent risk is assessed as "moderate," and the effectiveness of controls is "less than satisfactory." What would the residual risk conclusion most likely be?

options_en.A: "Medium," because weak controls would result in the residual risk remaining unchanged
options_en.B: "High," because weak controls would result in increased residual risk
options_en.C: "Moderate," because the risk conclusions for specific areas may be increased
options_en.D: "Low," because controls would lower the risk
